sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I'm Lisa. I live in the year 2095. I'm a student from Nova Middle School and I really love it!

At the school gate, a fingerprint recognition system helps ensure [1] as only students and school staff can enter.

Every week, we have a pet training programme where students can [2] their pets. While students are in class, AI-powered trainers teach pets problem-solving skills and even basic communication. Thanks to this, my dog Coco has become more [3]. Getting to different classes is easy. We just step onto a teleportation (远距离传送) stand, and within a second, we [4] at the right classroom! Floating desks can be [5] around the room, which allows students to rearrange (重新安排) their learning space easily.

As for homework, we complete it on a holographic (全息的) interactive board, which provides real-time feedback and detailed explanations. We have already replaced pens with the power of our [6] to control digital ink, making writing faster and easier. This means we don't need to move or say a single word. We just need to be focused and think clearly. PE classes are great! My favourite part is the underwater racetrack, where we ride small underwater motorcycles. In a health class, we sometimes use wheelchairs. They help us better understand the great difficulties faced by the [7] students in class. Field trips are also exciting. Our school bus is [8] a special kind of strong glass. It runs on clean energy and can travel on land, underwater, in the air, and even in space. Even a primary school student can operate it [9] without any difficulty. Underwater, it swims like a fish, and in the sky, it flies like a bird. What do you think of my school? To me, it's a wonderful place that truly [10] the way of learning.

questions.translation: 在学校门口，指纹识别系统有助于确保安全，因为只有学生和教职员工可以进入。
questions.explanation: 根据后文提到只有学生和教职工才能进入（only students and school staff can enter），说明指纹识别系统是为了确保校园安全（safety）。故选 safety。

questions.translation: 每周我们都有一个宠物训练项目，学生们可以带他们的宠物来。
questions.explanation: bring 表示将某物/某人“带来”，符合学生带宠物到学校参加训练项目的情境。故选 bring。

questions.translation: 多亏了这个，我的狗Coco变得更加聪明了。
questions.explanation: 前文提到AI训练师教宠物解决问题的技能和基础沟通，因此宠物变得更聪明（intelligent）。故选 intelligent。

questions.translation: 我们只要踏上瞬间传送台，一秒钟之内，我们就到达了正确的教室！
questions.explanation: 根据后文介词短语 at the right classroom 可知，arrive at 表示“到达”。故选 arrive。

questions.translation: 悬浮课桌可以在房间各处移动，这让学生们能轻松重新布置学习空间。
questions.explanation: 课桌是悬浮的（floating），并能重新布置学习空间，说明课桌可以在房间内被移动（moved）。故选 moved。

questions.translation: 我们已经用意念的力量来控制数字墨水取代了笔，让书写变得更快、更轻松。
questions.explanation: 后文提到“不需要移动或说一个字，只需要专注并清晰思考”，说明是用大脑/意念（minds）来控制数字墨水。故选 minds。

questions.translation: 它们帮助我们更好地理解班上残疾学生面临的巨大困难。
questions.explanation: 前文提到在健康课上使用轮椅（wheelchairs），目的是体验并理解残疾（disabled）同学的困难。故选 disabled。

questions.translation: 我们的校车是由一种特殊的坚固玻璃制成的。
questions.explanation: be made of 表示“由……制成”，且能看出原材料（玻璃制成车身）。故选 made of。

questions.translation: 甚至连小学生都能毫不费力地轻松操作它。
questions.explanation: 后文的 without any difficulty（毫无困难地）与 easily（容易地、轻松地）相对应。故选 easily。

questions.translation: 对我来说，这是一个真正改变了学习方式的美妙地方。
questions.explanation: 全文展示了2095年学校在教学、出行、写作业等各方面的巨大革新，真正改变了（changes）学习方式。故选 changes。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
In today's English class, Mr Miller asked us to think about the life in 50 years.

"Climate change and other pollution problems will get worse and influence the world badly," Sam said. Mr Miller asked us what we could do to make our planet better. Emma said, "We can start from small things, like saving water, turning off lights when we leave rooms, and using both sides of paper."

After hearing Emma's words, Mr Miller smiled and said, "Good job! Every small act counts. Scientists are also working hard to solve the pollution problems."

Another boy, Peter, said, "In the future, we will live better. We will have robots at home. They can help us do housework such as cooking, washing and cleaning. They can be a tutor (家庭教师) to teach us. They can also tell us how to solve our health problems."

Judie said, "People will live longer in the future. Some scientists are testing medicine (药) to help people live longer. By 2050, people may live to be over 100 years old."

Mr Miller was <u>pleased</u> with our answers. He smiled and asked us to work hard for the bright future.

questions.prompt: What is Emma's opinion on protecting our planet?
options: Turn off lights when leaving rooms.
questions.translation: 关于保护我们的星球，Emma的观点是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段中 Emma 所说 'We can start from small things, like saving water, turning off lights when we leave rooms, and using both sides of paper.' 可知，离开房间时关灯符合其观点。故选 Turn off lights when leaving rooms。

questions.prompt: What can't robots do according to Peter?
options: They can't cook dinner for us.
They can't teach kids to learn anything.
They can't help us solve health problems.
questions.translation: 根据Peter的说法，机器人不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段提到机器人可以做家务（cooking, washing and cleaning）、当家教辅导（be a tutor to teach us）以及告知如何解决健康问题（tell us how to solve our health problems），文中未提及机器人能感知人类情感。故选 They can't sense our feelings。

questions.prompt: What is Judie's idea about the future?
options: People will move to another planet by 2050.
We will live longer with the help of scientists.
questions.translation: Judie对未来的看法是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第5段 'People will live longer in the future. Some scientists are testing medicine (药) to help people live longer.' 可知，在科学家的帮助下人们寿命会更长。故选 We will live longer with the help of scientists。

questions.prompt: Which word is close to the underlined word "pleased"?
questions.translation: 哪个单词与划线单词“pleased”意思相近？
questions.explanation: 根据第6段 'Mr Miller was pleased with our answers. He smiled...'，米勒老师面带微笑，说明他对大家的回答感到满意和高兴（Happy）。故选 Happy。

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the text?
options: Learn More Skills for the Future
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文围绕英语课上老师让大家思考50年后的生活，学生们各自分享对未来环境、机器人、寿命等方面的畅想与梦想。Dream about the Future（畅想未来）最能概括文章主旨。故选 Dream about the Future。

sections.title: 三、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从短文后的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有两项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
Some of the jobs were common fifty years ago, but we can't see any of them now. And some popular jobs today may disappear in twenty years. [1] Let's have a look.

### Space tour guide
People are excited about traveling to space. [2] When people go to space, they will need a guide. The guide will tell them what they see and keep them safe. Of course, the guide must be good at communicating.

### AI psychologist (心理学家)
AI is being used in more jobs, and machines will act more like people. They will need someone to help their "minds" work right. AI psychologists know about both feelings and machines. [3] They make sure that smart computers think clearly and act safely.

### Human-technology integration (融合) expert
In the future, people need help to understand new technologies and know how to use them well. So experts in human-technology might be very important. [4] They will also give advice on how to use them in the best way.

### Robot trainer
[5] They will teach robots to be polite and friendly. They will make sure robots can help in homes, hospitals, or schools without causing problems.
wordbank: Their job is to help AI.
It will be possible one day.
So what future jobs do we need?
More robots will work with people.
These guides will also need to be astronauts.
Robot trainers will be like teachers for robots.
They will teach people how to use new technologies.

questions.translation: 空格[1]填空
questions.explanation: 前文提到过去的工作消失了，现在的工作未来也可能消失，承上启下提出问题“那么我们需要哪些未来的工作呢？”，引出下文介绍的各种未来职业。故选 "So what future jobs do we need?"。

questions.translation: 空格[2]填空
questions.explanation: 前文提到人们对太空旅行感到兴奋，后文提到人们去太空时需要导游，此处说明太空旅行在未来的某一天将成为可能。故选 "It will be possible one day."。

questions.translation: 空格[3]填空
questions.explanation: 本段介绍AI心理学家，他们兼懂情感和机器，其主要工作就是辅助人工智能（help AI），确保智能计算机思路清晰。故选 "Their job is to help AI."。

questions.translation: 空格[4]填空
questions.explanation: 本段介绍人机融合专家，前句提到人们需要帮助以理解和使用新技术，后文提到他们会提供如何最好地使用技术的建议，因此此处指他们会教人们如何使用新技术。故选 "They will teach people how to use new technologies."。

questions.translation: 空格[5]填空
questions.explanation: 本段介绍机器人训练师（Robot trainer），后文提到他们会教机器人礼貌友好，因此机器人训练师就像是机器人的老师。故选 "Robot trainers will be like teachers for robots."。

sections.title: 四、语法填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
What will life be like in China in 2035? People will improve their lives greatly.

University classes will be open to all people who would like to learn something new. Everyone can get the best education [1] the Internet. With the development of technology (科技), there [2] (be) a new app called Fresh Food. With the help of the app, people won't need to prepare food [3] (them). After getting up, they can take [4] (sandwich) from a special box. And it will even serve many kinds of foods if someone [5] (invite) friends for dinner. It will really save quite a lot of time.

After dinner, people will do some exercise in [6] (they) own apartments. Their apartments will be covered with enough green plants. On weekends, they will be able to enjoy blue skies and fresh air in the park [7] (quiet), because there will be [8] (little) pollution and more trees.

[9] there will be more cars in cities, the traffic (交通) won't be so heavy, because people won't have to go out. They will just stay at home and work online. Students from all over the world may study together on the Internet, too.

In a word, life will be much simpler and greener! People can't wait [10] (live) the better life in 2035.

questions.translation: 每个人都可以通过互联网获得最好的教育。
questions.explanation: through the Internet 意为“通过互联网”，through 表示通过某种媒介或方式。故选 through。

questions.translation: 随着科技的发展，将会有一款名为“Fresh Food”的新应用程序。
questions.explanation: 全文描述2035年未来的生活，there be 句型的一般将来时为 there will be。故选 will be。

questions.translation: 在应用程序的帮助下，人们将不需要自己准备食物。
questions.explanation: 主语 people 和动作执行者一致，for oneself / by oneself 意为“亲自、自己”，此处应用反身代词 themselves。故选 themselves。

questions.translation: 起床后，他们可以从一个特殊的盒子里拿三明治。
questions.explanation: sandwich 是可数名词，以 ch 结尾，复数形式加 -es 变为 sandwiches。故选 sandwiches。

questions.translation: 如果有人邀请朋友吃晚饭，它甚至会提供多种食物。
questions.explanation: if 引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；从句主语 someone 为不定代词，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 invites。故选 invites。

questions.translation: 晚饭后，人们会在他们自己的公寓里做一些运动。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 apartments，且与 own 连用（one's own ...），应用形容词性物主代词 their。故选 their。

questions.translation: 在周末，他们将能够在公园里安静地享受蓝天和新鲜空气……
questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语 enjoy blue skies and fresh air 作状语，应用副词 quietly。故选 quietly。

questions.translation: ……因为污染会更少，树木会更多。
questions.explanation: pollution 是不可数名词，且与后文的比较级 more trees 形成对比并列，应用 little 的比较级 less。故选 less。

questions.translation: 尽管城市里会有更多的汽车，但交通不会那么拥堵……
questions.explanation: 前后句存在让步转折关系（虽然车多了，但交通并不拥堵），引导让步状语从句应用 Although，位于句首首字母大写。故选 Although。

questions.translation: 人们迫不及待地想要在2035年过上更美好的生活。
questions.explanation: can't wait to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“迫不及待要做某事”，后接动词不定式。故选 to live。

sections.title: 五、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，根据短文内容从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
The World Future Society (世界未来学会) writes reports about how modern technology (现代科技) will change our lives.

### People
People may live up to 120 years old. They will use new technology to help them look young. The number of people over a hundred years old could go to 2.2 million by 2050.

### Money
Worldwide e-business (全球电子商务) will become even more successful with online shopping. Businesses will sell special products (产品) for each person and all products will be sent to people's houses the next day.

### Environment
In the future, wind and solar energy could become much cheaper and many more countries could use them. This would be very useful in poor countries. The air in big cities would also become much cleaner and healthier as a result.

### Society and culture
The Internet will help to create more worldwide friendships. Families may spend more time together as people will be able to do 24-hour online banking and shopping.

questions.prompt: How old may people live up to in the future?
questions.translation: 未来人们可能活到多少岁？
questions.explanation: 根据文章 People 部分第一句 'People may live up to 120 years old.' 可知。故选 Up to 120 years old。

questions.prompt: When will the products be sent to people's houses through online shopping?
questions.translation: 通过网购，产品什么时候会被送到人们家中？
questions.explanation: 根据文章 Money 部分最后一句 'all products will be sent to people's houses the next day.' 可知是次日送到。故选 The next day。

questions.prompt: What are the changes that modern technology will bring to our future in the passage? List two.
options: More crowded traffic and heavy pollution.
Less time with family and fewer friendships.
More expensive goods and slower deliveries.
questions.translation: 文章中现代科技将给我们的未来带来哪些改变？列举两条。
questions.explanation: 文中指出未来人们寿命更长（People live up to 120 years old），风能和太阳能等清洁能源更便宜（wind and solar energy could become much cheaper）。故选 Cheaper energy and longer life。

questions.prompt: What do you think we should do to prepare for the future?
options: Study hard, learn new skills, and protect the environment.
Wait at home and rely completely on robots.
Give up all online activities and communications.
questions.translation: 你认为我们应该做些什么来为未来做好准备？
questions.explanation: 面对科技日新月异、人均寿命延长与环保要求提高的未来，我们应当努力学习、掌握新技能并爱护环境，积极拥抱未来。故选 Study hard, learn new skills, and protect the environment。
